title: FACT: Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins
abstract: arXiv:2609.37067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visually plausible articulated assets may still fail during contact interactions or exhibit inaccurate motion. We present FACT (Fidelity-Aware Construction of Articulated Twins), an agentic framework that progressively constructs articulated twins to improve geometry, contact, and dynamic fidelity. The agent drives an evidence--diagnosis--revision loop on a shared editable representation, selecting measurements and model edits using quantitative feedback, while numerical tools execute and validate the updates. It reconstructs editable articulated geometry from images through feature planning, targeted measurements, and diagnostic refinement. On this reference, it repairs collision proxies through task-aware local repartitioning before fidelity-constrained compression. Finally, it constructs response models from passive-response videos, using simulation residuals to guide model revision and constrained physical parameter fitting. Experi

translated_title: FACT：保真度感知的铰接孪生体构建
translated_abstract: 视觉上逼真的铰接资产在接触交互中仍可能失效，或表现出不准确的运动。我们提出了FACT（保真度感知的铰接孪生体构建），这是一个智能体框架，通过渐进式构建铰接孪生体来提升其几何、接触和动力学保真度。该智能体在共享的可编辑表示上驱动“证据—诊断—修正”循环，利用定量反馈来选择测量方式和模型编辑操作，同时由数值工具执行并验证更新。该框架首先通过特征规划、针对性测量和诊断性细化，从图像中重建可编辑的铰接几何；在此基础上，在保真度约束压缩之前，通过任务感知的局部重划分来修复碰撞代理；最后，从被动响应视频中构建响应模型，利用仿真残差来指导模型修正和受约束的物理参数拟合。
tldr: FACT提出了一种智能体框架，通过证据—诊断—修正循环渐进式构建铰接孪生体，同时提升其几何、接触和动力学三个层面的保真度。
en_tdlr: FACT introduces an agentic framework that progressively constructs articulated twins through an evidence-diagnosis-revision loop, jointly improving geometry, contact, and dynamic fidelity.
